name: Innovator Founder visa

requirements.blocker_text: This requires endorsement from an approved endorsing body confirming your business idea is new, innovative, viable and scalable.
requirements.fix_path: Apply to an approved endorsing body with a business plan meeting the innovation, viability and scalability criteria.

requirements.blocker_text: This requires £1,270 held for 28 consecutive days (no separate minimum investment requirement for entry — that only applies to certain settlement criteria).
requirements.fix_path: Hold the required funds continuously for 28 days before applying.

requirements.blocker_text: This requires English at CEFR B2.
requirements.fix_path: Take an approved Secure English Language Test at B2.

evidence_required.document: Endorsement letter from an approved endorsing body
Bank statements showing £1,270 held for 28 consecutive days

notes: Sole active endorsement-based entrepreneur route as of this verification — the old Start-up and Innovator visas both closed 13 April 2023, and Innovator Founder is their consolidated successor. Application fee £1,357 (outside UK) / £1,693 (in-UK switch/extend) confirmed via gov.uk; secondary sources showing £1,274/£1,590 are stale. Separate endorsement fee of £1,000 to the endorsing body, plus £500 per required contact-point meeting (minimum two, at 12 and 24 months) — these endorsing-body fees are NOT part of the gov.uk application fee and are paid directly to the endorsing body; not yet modeled as a distinct cost field, captured here in notes only pending a schema decision on whether third-party (non-government) mandatory fees need their own field. ILR after 3 years requires meeting settlement criteria (e.g. two of seven published success criteria) — not a flat time-served rule like most other routes, closer in shape to the Global Talent tiered-outcome gap already flagged on uk_global_talent and uk_ilr.
